title: Istanbul, Süleymaniye Kütüphanesi, Ayasofya 4832
lineage: Inspected the identified passages; retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.note: The scholarly catalog dates the main manuscript hand to the 11th century, notes later additions on separate folios, and describes the Kindian portion of the codex. A 1173 ownership statement is not a copy date.
